propositions: Two regexes and one scope extractor key on `## Success Criteria` heading, making it load-bearing and blocking store migration verification until they are repointed to `## Acceptance Criteria`

Epic branch of `_clarity_score` currently grants +2 bonus for `## Success Criteria`; repointing to `## Acceptance Criteria` keeps the epic score at 6 (score-neutral), avoiding a regression across 108 migrated tickets if the bonus were dropped
The two `_clarity_score` copies in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep; both must be updated together to repoint the epic branch from SC to AC
`_SCOPE_HEADINGS` in assemble.py lists both `## success criteria` and `## acceptance criteria`; the SC entry must be dropped since AC is already universal

Test fixtures in seven files embed `## Success Criteria` in ticket descriptions; fixtures with both headings drop the SC block, and fixtures with only SC are renamed to `## Acceptance Criteria` with bullets converted to `- [ ]` items
New contract test `test_criteria_heading_collapse.py` must assert `_clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') == 6` to prove the repoint is score-neutral and not an assumption
